requested: repair the three offline Unit A checkpoint, lineage, and module-evidence gaps
forbidden: training, simulation, server, Git, or policy-quality work

review.scope: checkpoint repair ownership, lifecycle, persistence, and proof route

source_edits.scope: local repair of the three Unit A formal-audit gaps

report_write.scope: local plan, migration, module, review, and formal-audit evidence

repository_discipline.rationale: The plan keeps scripts assembly-only, adds a narrow optional runner dependency, declares backend capability publicly, and performs asset identity work only on the env cold path.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: FADA owns identity/validation, the generic runner only dispatches persistence, the runtime composes dependencies, and G1 exposes one immutable cold-path snapshot.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: One checkpoint saver port and one immutable identity record replace scattered metadata primitives and filename inference.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: The runner remains FADA-agnostic and the environment has no dependency on learner or persistence modules.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Identity is sealed before save, revalidated after reload, rejected before learner mutation, and finalized only after the exact 20+1 set exists.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: Generic persistence receives one optional dependency with a characterized default; all FADA rules stay in the FADA owner.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Module persistence evidence, formal integration, and policy quality remain separate gates.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: The plan requires RED sensitivity, strict invalid/identity cases, 20+1 lifecycle proof, generic regression, migration matrix, current module manifest, and a rerun of the formal audit.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: The sealed identity binds obs, critic, privilege and action dimensions plus layout/body/actuator order without changing tensor values.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: The repair does not change loss, gradient, optimizer grouping, or update count; rejection tests assert optimizer/model state remains untouched.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: STATE_SCHEMA policy is explicit: incomplete/old payloads reject, new payloads strict-round-trip, and mixed campaign binaries are unsupported.

residual_risks.description: Offline construction cannot by itself prove actual MuJoCo/replay/update integration or policy quality.
residual_risks.disposition: Rerun formal-runtime-audit after module and migration closure; keep long training separately authorized.
